studies.question: Conditional nominal-GP local/global significance on 0.5 MeV grid
studies.meaning: Observed likelihood roots frozen. Local z=(r-a)/s is a changed, source-dependent ordering; 256 exact scans test 200000 Gaussian fields in moderate tails only.

studies.question: Interpretation of resolution, covariance, LEE and CLs; no new fits or random draws
studies.meaning: Real response covariance already carries detector and background-fit correlations. FWHM Sidak underestimates fitted-field tails at observed thresholds; neither correction qualifies physical null.

studies.meaning: Same data, distinct alternative hypotheses. Width changes do not settle source validity. Selection among methods/widths uncalibrated. One full-2016 2.6-sigma peak-global direct check is flagged.

coherence.competing_peak_note: For 2021, the region maximum changes from 93 to the 80 MeV diagnostic boundary at widths 2.5 and 2.6. This is a competing-excursion rank switch, not evidence of a resonance moving 13 MeV. No narrower optimized diagnostic region is introduced.

definition.weighted_center: mbar = sum_d,w mhat_d,w / sigma_d(92)^2 divided by sum_d,w 1 / sigma_d(92)^2
definition.peak_ordering: Maximum signed standardized Z=(r-a)/s among raw r>0 grid sites; exact ties choose lowest mass
definition.requested_peak_ordering: Individual 80--105/support summary maximizes signed Z across all available sites; the calibrated common-region coherence additionally requires positive raw r. All reported observed peaks satisfy raw r>0.
definition.ineligible_rule: If any dataset-width has no positive raw r in region, set T and W to infinity (never counted as coherent)
definition.region_reason: 2015 support ends at 100 MeV; all-dataset coherence uses the common intersection 80--100. Individual requested-region summaries retain 80--105 where supported.
definition.secondary_statistic: W = mean_d ( [max_w mhat_d,w - min_w mhat_d,w] / sigma_d(92) )^2
definition.tail: Inclusive lower tail; small values mean more coherent/stable. T is the single primary scalar; T and W p values are not multiplied.
definition.significance_interpretation: Exploratory fixed-region conditional null diagnostic; not a discovery p value, not corrected for region, method, or width selection
definition.direct_null: 256 paired full-spectrum Poisson rows with exact profile scans, reused at every mass and width
definition.gaussian_null: 100000 supplemental linear-response Gaussian draws per independent dataset; full covariance across all diagnostic masses and widths from stacked D columns
definition.amplitude_units: Amplitude A is epsilon2/1e-8 in the original dataset template parameterization; amplitudes are independent here. Full-spectrum signal events=A*sum(full Gaussian template); window signal events=A*sum(window template). Nonnegative MLE=max(A,0).

studies.meaning: q_R=sum_d max(r_d,0)^2 is exact likelihood statistic, not a Z. Conditional local/global calibration remains source-dependent. Peak clustering provides no unusual coherence.

clarifications.finding: Colored curve a is raw deterministic signed root; black and gray are mean and SD of standardized complete-Poisson roots. Near-zero black curve is conditional centering check, not proof no signal absorption.
10th-90th percentile spread across mass-pair locations at fixed separation; not statistical uncertainty.
Common hypothetical reference-local threshold, not observed mass or recalibrated signal strength; thresholds>=1.5 exceed all positive-fit gates.
Tests at2.4/2.5/2.6 move extractor mask AND fit window, never full-source construction. No3-sigma comparison was performed in these old studies. Keep2.25 as instructed.
LEE adjusts background-only discovery tails, not pointwise90%CLs limits; reported significance changes cannot be read as reach degradation.
